info.title: Event manager attendee API
info.description: Registration for attendees, behind the hosted pages. No accounts: open registration takes an occurrence id, the rest a signed manage token.

manageToken.description: The token from the registration's manage link

invitationToken.description: The token from the guest's personal invitation link

get.summary: An occurrence open for registration, with its availability

locale.description: Locale of the texts: the requested one, or the account default

guestAllowed.description: Whether "I will bring a guest" is offered

status.description: waitlist: full, but registering joins the waitlist. closed: registration has not opened, has closed, or the occurrence is cancelled. New statuses may be added

opensAt.description: Null: open as soon as the event is published

availability.description: Places for registration occurrences, without exact numbers. Null for other admission modes

type.description: dietary: free text, always sensitive. text: one line or multiline, optionally sensitive. checkbox: e.g. consent to photos. choice: one or several options

sensitive.description: Stored encrypted, shown only with registrations.sensitive, deleted soon after the occurrence

fields.description: Asked after name and email, in this order

sensitiveDeleteAfterDays.description: Sensitive answers are deleted this many days after the occurrence; for the consent text

post.summary: Register; confirmed at once, or on the waitlist when full (status waitlisted). Returns the manage token

partySize.description: 2 brings a guest, where the event allows it

consent.description: Agreement to sensitive answers being stored; required when any is given

status.description: waitlisted: in line for a place. offered: a place is held until offerExpiresAt; claim it with /registration/claim

waitlistPosition.description: Place in line while waitlisted (1 = next)

answers.description: By field id: text, true for a ticked checkbox, option ids for a choice

manageToken.description: Bearer token for /registration. Also in the confirmation email's link; keep it private
